fullPassage:
Keep Trying and Keep Hoping

People all over the world are making efforts to save the environment. Some have succeeded, some have failed, but remember that every little change helps.

Seaweed Hamburger Packages

Most food packaging is coated with plastic, making it nearly impossible to recycle. Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in seaweed. A team of researchers has invented an alternative material from seaweed native to South Australia. The new coating material works almost like plastic, helping prevent food from sticking to paper, while also breaking down more easily than plastic. The material can be made into thin films that can be coated on various surfaces, such as paper or fabric. The fast-food industry is welcoming the news, with major restaurant brands planning to choose greener packaging by 2025.

Your Leather Bags Are Going Un-Leather

What is made of leather? Bags, shoes, clothes, car seats, and the list goes on. Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves. To many customers' relief, since then, many other eco-friendly ingredients have been tested, and some have been proven to make alternative leathers. Grape waste from the wine industry and a mushroom grown from farming waste have been successfully turned into leather-like sheets. As consumer demand for eco-friendly products continues to grow, more will be invented and used. The market for eco-friendly leather alternatives is growing rapidly. In 2022, the market was valued at $725 million and is expected to reach $1.2 billion by 2030.

questions.passage: Most food packaging is coated with plastic, making it nearly impossible to recycle. Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in seaweed. A team of researchers has invented an (A)[alternative / identical] material from seaweed native to South Australia. The new coating material works almost like plastic, helping (B)[prevent / promote] food from sticking to paper, while also breaking down more (C)[easily / hardly] than plastic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 연구팀이 해초에서 대안(alternative) 소재를 발명했다. 음식이 종이에 붙는 것을 방지(prevent)한다. 플라스틱보다 더 쉽게(easily) 분해된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① alternative — prevent — easily: 원문 일치
❌ ② identical(동일한): 플라스틱 대체재이므로 alternative(대안의)가 적절
❌ ③ promote(촉진): 음식이 붙는 것을 촉진하면 안 됨, hardly(거의 ~않게): easily의 반의어
❌ ④ identical + promote: 둘 다 부적절
det.tip: alternative(대안의) ↔ identical(동일한), prevent(방지) ↔ promote(촉진), easily(쉽게) ↔ hardly(거의 ~않게)

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the (A)[majority / minority] of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more (B)[environmentally / economically] friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves. To many customers' (C)[relief / dismay], since then, many other eco-friendly ingredients have been tested.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 석유 기반 가죽은 인조 가죽의 대다수(majority)를 차지한다. 더 환경(environmentally) 친화적인 선택지를 찾으려 했다. 많은 고객의 안도(relief)에 이르러 시험되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ majority — environmentally — relief: 원문 일치
❌ ① minority(소수): majority(대다수)의 반의어
❌ ② economically(경제적으로): environmentally(환경적으로)와 다른 의미, dismay(실망): relief(안도)의 반의어
❌ ④ dismay(실망): 친환경 재료 시험은 고객에게 안도를 줌
det.tip: majority(다수) ↔ minority(소수), environmentally(환경적으로) vs economically(경제적으로), relief(안도) ↔ dismay(실망)

questions.passage: Grape waste from the wine industry and a mushroom grown from farming waste have been (A)[successfully / unsuccessfully] turned into leather-like sheets. As consumer demand for eco-friendly products continues to (B)[grow / decline], more will be invented and used. The market for eco-friendly leather alternatives is growing (C)[rapidly / gradually]. In 2022, the market was valued at $725 million and is expected to reach $1.2 billion by 2030.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 폐기물이 성공적으로(successfully) 가죽 시트로 전환되었다. 소비자 수요가 계속 증가(grow)한다. 시장이 빠르게(rapidly) 성장 중이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② successfully — grow — rapidly: 원문 일치. $725M→$1.2B 수치가 rapidly의 근거
❌ ① decline(감소): grow(증가)의 반의어. 수요가 감소하면 시장 성장과 모순
❌ ③ unsuccessfully(실패적으로): successfully의 반의어, gradually(서서히): 수치상 빠른 성장
❌ ④ gradually(서서히): $725M→$1.2B은 급격한 성장
det.tip: successfully ↔ unsuccessfully, grow ↔ decline, rapidly ↔ gradually. 수치 데이터가 난이도 판단의 단서

questions.passage: People all over the world are making efforts to save the environment. Some have ①<u>succeeded</u>, some have failed, but remember that every little change helps. Most food packaging is ②<u>coated</u> with plastic, making it nearly impossible to ③<u>recycle</u>. Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in ④<u>leather</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 햄버거가 곧 해초(seaweed)로 감싸질 수 있다. leather(가죽)는 원문의 seaweed(해초)를 잘못 바꾼 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ leather(가죽) → seaweed(해초)가 원문. 해초 기반 포장재를 발명했다는 문맥
❌ ① succeeded(성공했다): 원문 그대로
❌ ② coated(코팅된): 원문 그대로
❌ ③ recycle(재활용하다): 원문 그대로
det.tip: seaweed(해초) — 이 단락의 주제는 해초 포장재. leather는 두 번째 단락 주제

questions.passage: The new coating material works almost like plastic, helping ①<u>prevent</u> food from sticking to paper, while also breaking down more easily than plastic. The material can be made into thin films that can be coated on ②<u>limited</u> surfaces, such as paper or fabric. The fast-food industry is ③<u>welcoming</u> the news, with major restaurant brands planning to choose greener ④<u>packaging</u> by 2025.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다양한 표면에 코팅할 수 있다. limited(제한된)는 원문의 various(다양한)를 잘못 바꾼 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② limited(제한된) → various(다양한)가 원문. such as paper or fabric이 '다양한' 표면의 예시
❌ ① prevent(방지하다): 원문 그대로
❌ ③ welcoming(환영하는): 원문 그대로
❌ ④ packaging(포장): 원문 그대로
det.tip: various(다양한) ↔ limited(제한된). such as 뒤에 여러 예시 나열이 various의 근거

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options. To many customers' ①<u>relief</u>, since then, many other eco-friendly ingredients have been tested, and some have been ②<u>proven</u> to make alternative leathers. Grape waste from the wine industry and a mushroom grown from farming waste have been successfully turned into leather-like sheets. As consumer ③<u>demand</u> for eco-friendly products continues to grow, more will be invented and used. The market for eco-friendly leather alternatives is growing ④<u>gradually</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 친환경 가죽 대안 시장은 빠르게(rapidly) 성장하고 있다. gradually(서서히)는 rapidly(빠르게)의 반의어이므로 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ gradually(서서히) → rapidly(빠르게)가 원문. $725M에서 $1.2B으로 성장하는 수치가 '빠른 성장' 단서
❌ ① relief(안도): 원문 그대로
❌ ② proven(입증된): 원문 그대로
❌ ③ demand(수요): 원문 그대로
det.tip: rapidly(빠르게) ↔ gradually(서서히). 뒤에 나오는 구체적 수치($725M → $1.2B)가 rapid growth의 근거

questions.passage: People all over the world are making efforts to save the environment. Some have succeeded, some have failed, but remember that every little change helps. Most food packaging is coated with plastic, making it nearly impossible to recycle. Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in seaweed. A team of researchers has invented an __________ material from seaweed native to South Australia.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 연구팀이 해초에서 대안(alternative) 소재를 발명했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ alternative(대안의): 플라스틱의 대체재로서 해초 소재를 발명한 문맥
❌ ① artificial(인공의): 해초는 자연 재료
❌ ② original(원래의): 새로 발명한 것
❌ ④ traditional(전통적인): 새로운 발명
det.tip: alternative = 대안의, 대체의. '기존 것을 대체하는 새로운 것'이라는 의미

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves. To many customers' relief, since then, many other eco-friendly ingredients have been tested, and some have been __________ to make alternative leathers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 친환경 재료가 시험되었고, 일부는 대안 가죽을 만드는 데 입증(proven)되었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ proven(입증된): 시험(tested)한 후 효과가 입증되었다는 자연스러운 흐름
❌ ① refused(거부된): 긍정적 결과 맥락에 부적절
❌ ② designed(설계된): tested → proven이 논리적
❌ ④ expected(기대된): 이미 결과가 나온 상황이므로 부적절
det.tip: prove = 입증하다. have been proven to V = ~하는 것으로 입증되다

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, __________ a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves. Grape waste from the wine industry and a mushroom grown from farming waste have been successfully turned into leather-like sheets.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 석유 기반 가죽은 생산에 많은 에너지를 필요로(require) 하고, 분해에 오랜 시간이 걸린다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② require(필요로 하다): 에너지가 많이 필요하다 → 환경 문제 → 대안 찾는 흐름
❌ ① release(방출하다): 에너지를 방출하는 것이 아님
❌ ③ conserve(보존하다): 반대 의미
❌ ④ generate(생성하다): 에너지를 생성하는 것이 아님
det.tip: require = 필요로 하다. require a lot of energy = 많은 에너지를 필요로 하다

questions.passage: People all over the world are making efforts to save the <u>environment</u>. Some have succeeded, some have failed, but remember that every little change helps. Most food packaging is coated with plastic, making it nearly impossible to recycle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 environment와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 전 세계 사람들이 환경(environment)을 살리기 위해 노력하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② surroundings(주변 환경): environment(환경)과 동의어
❌ ① industry(산업): 무관
❌ ③ community(공동체): 환경과 다른 개념
❌ ④ economy(경제): 무관
det.tip: environment(환경) = surroundings(주변 환경). ecosystem, nature도 유사어

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the <u>majority</u> of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 majority와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 석유 기반 가죽은 인조 가죽의 대다수(majority)를 차지한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ bulk(대부분): majority(대다수)와 동의어. the bulk of = 대부분의
❌ ① minority(소수): majority의 반의어
❌ ② variety(다양성): 양이 아닌 종류의 다양성
❌ ③ portion(일부): 대다수가 아닌 일부분
det.tip: majority(대다수) = bulk(대부분). the majority of = the bulk of = 대부분의

questions.passage: As consumer demand for eco-friendly products continues to grow, more will be invented and used. The market for eco-friendly leather alternatives is growing <u>rapidly</u>. In 2022, the market was valued at $725 million and is expected to reach $1.2 billion by 2030.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 rapidly와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 친환경 가죽 대안 시장은 빠르게(rapidly) 성장하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① swiftly(빠르게): rapidly(빠르게)와 동의어
❌ ② steadily(꾸준히): 속도가 아닌 안정성 강조
❌ ③ moderately(적당히): 빠르지 않은 중간 속도
❌ ④ marginally(약간): rapidly와 거의 반대
det.tip: rapidly(빠르게) = swiftly = quickly. steadily(꾸준히)는 속도보다 지속성 강조

questions.passage: Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in seaweed. A team of researchers has invented an alternative material from seaweed <u>native</u> to South Australia. The new coating material works almost like plastic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 native와 의미가 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 남호주 토착(native) 해초에서 소재를 만들었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② foreign(외국의): native(토착의)의 반의어
❌ ① indigenous(토착의): native와 동의어
❌ ③ domestic(국내의): native와 유사
❌ ④ local(지역의): native와 유사
det.tip: native(토착의) ↔ foreign(외국의). indigenous(토착의)는 native의 동의어

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of <u>artificial</u> leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 artificial과 의미가 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 인조(artificial) 가죽의 대다수를 차지한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ genuine(진짜의): artificial(인조의)의 반의어
❌ ① synthetic(합성의): artificial과 동의어
❌ ② fake(가짜의): artificial과 유사
❌ ④ manufactured(제조된): artificial과 유사
det.tip: artificial(인조의) ↔ genuine(진짜의) / natural(천연의). synthetic, fake는 동의어

questions.passage:
(A) The new coating material works almost like plastic, helping prevent food from sticking to paper, while also <u>breaking down</u> more easily than plastic.

(B) Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to <u>break down</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 break(ing) down의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 플라스틱보다 더 쉽게 분해되다(breaking down). (B) 분해에 오랜 시간이 걸린다 — 분해되다(break down).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (A) 분해되다 — (B) 분해되다: 둘 다 물질이 자연적으로 분해되는 의미
❌ ① 고장나다/분석하다: 기계 고장이나 데이터 분석 맥락 아님
❌ ② 분석하다/고장나다: 순서 바꿔도 부적절
❌ ③ 무너지다/분석하다: 물질 분해 맥락에 부적합
det.tip: break down = 분해되다(물질), 고장나다(기계), 무너지다(감정), 분석하다(데이터). 여기서는 둘 다 '분해되다'

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"the desire of consumers to obtain goods or services"

det.korean: 소비자가 상품이나 서비스를 얻으려는 욕구 = 수요(demand)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ demand(수요): 영영풀이와 정확히 일치
❌ ① supply(공급): demand의 반대 개념
❌ ② relief(안도): 감정 상태로 무관
❌ ④ effort(노력): 시도하는 행위로 다른 의미
det.tip: demand(수요) ↔ supply(공급). consumer demand = 소비자 수요

questions.passage: So companies have been trying to find more __________ (environment) friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves.
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 기업들은 더 환경적으로(environmentally) 친화적인 선택지를 찾으려 노력해왔다.
det.analysis: ✅ environmentally: friendly(형용사)를 수식하므로 부사형 필요. environment(명사) → environmentally(부사)
det.tip: environment(명사) → environmental(형용사) → environmentally(부사). 형용사를 수식할 때는 부사

questions.passage: The market for eco-friendly leather alternatives is growing rapidly. In 2022, the market was __________ (value) at $725 million and is expected to reach $1.2 billion by 2030.
questions.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 2022년에 그 시장은 7억 2,500만 달러로 평가되었다(was valued).
det.analysis: ✅ valued: was __________ 수동태 구조. value(동사) → valued(과거분사)
det.tip: be valued at = ~으로 평가되다. value(가치) → valued(평가된). was + p.p. 수동태

questions.passage: Most food packaging is coated with plastic, making it nearly impossible to recycle. Believe it or not, your hamburger could soon be wrapped in seaweed. A team of researchers has invented an alternative material from seaweed native to South Australia. The new coating material works almost like plastic, helping prevent food from sticking to paper, while also __________ more easily than plastic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 새 코팅 소재는 플라스틱보다 더 쉽게 분해된다(breaking down).
det.analysis:
✅ ② breaking down(분해되다): 플라스틱 대안이므로 더 쉽게 분해된다는 문맥
❌ ① building up(쌓이다): 분해와 반대
❌ ③ carrying out(수행하다): 소재가 수행하는 것은 부자연스러움
❌ ④ setting off(출발하다): 문맥 무관
det.tip: break down = 분해되다. build up(쌓이다)은 반의어. 환경 소재의 핵심은 생분해성

questions.passage: Oil-based leathers, which make up the majority of artificial leathers, require a lot of energy to produce and a long time to break down. So companies have been trying to find more environmentally friendly options. The first success came in the 1990s, when a company made leather from pineapple leaves. Grape waste from the wine industry and a mushroom grown from farming waste have been successfully __________ leather-like sheets.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 포도 찌꺼기와 버섯이 성공적으로 가죽 같은 시트로 전환되었다(turned into).
det.analysis:
✅ ① turned into(~로 전환되다): 폐기물이 가죽 시트로 변환된다는 원문 문맥
❌ ② broken down into(~로 분해되다): 분해가 아닌 변환 맥락
❌ ③ made up of(~로 구성되다): 구성이 아닌 변환 맥락
❌ ④ carried out as(~로 수행되다): 소재 변환과 무관
det.tip: turn A into B = A를 B로 바꾸다/전환하다. be turned into = ~로 전환되다
